input.command: cd src/packages/cli; cat src/commands/providers-commands.ts; cat src/commands/providers/writeVerbs.ts
cd src/packages/cli; cat __tests__/providersWriteVerbs.test.ts; P=$(find ../provider -name connectionStoreHome.ts -not -path '*/node_modules/*'); echo $P; cat $P; ls __tests__ | grep -i provider

cd src/packages/cli; bun test __tests__/providersWriteVerbs.test.ts __tests__/providersCommands.test.ts __tests__/providersLoginVerb.test.ts __tests__/providersTestVerbs.test.ts __tests__/providersAnthropicCredential.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -n "openStore\|close" __tests__/providersCommands.test.ts | head -20

cd src/packages/cli; F=src/commands/providers-commands.ts; B=$(mktemp); cp $F $B
T="__tests__/providersWriteVerbs.test.ts __tests__/providersCommands.test.ts __tests__/providersLoginVerb.test.ts __tests__/providersTestVerbs.test.ts __tests__/providersAnthropicCredential.test.ts"
OLD='  const opened = openOnFirstUse(deps.openStore)' NEW='  const opened = deps.openStore()' bash ../../../bin/replace_literal $F >/dev/null
echo "== A1 apertura inmediata"; bun test $T 2>&1 | grep -E "\(fail\)|pass$|fail$"
cp $B $F
OLD='    close: () => opened?.close(),' NEW='    close: () => (opened ??= open()).close(),' bash ../../../bin/replace_literal $F >/dev/null
echo "== A2 close abre si no se abrió"; bun test $T 2>&1 | grep -E "\(fail\)|pass$|fail$"
cp $B $F; rm -f "${B:?}"; git diff --stat

cd src/packages/cli; bun test __tests__/providersWriteVerbs.test.ts __tests__/providersCommands.test.ts __tests__/providersLoginVerb.test.ts __tests__/providersTestVerbs.test.ts __tests__/providersAnthropicCredential.test.ts 2>&1 | grep -E "pass$|fail$"; cd ../../..; timeout 300 bash bin/check_package_typecheck --strict cli 2>&1 | tail -8; D=$(mktemp -d); THYROX_PROVIDERS_DATA_DIR=$D X=sk timeout 60 bash bin/cli providers add anthropic --credential-env X --dry-run; echo "exit=$? entradas=$(ls -A "$D" | wc -l)"; rm -rf "${D:?}"
D=$(mktemp -d); THYROX_PROVIDERS_DATA_DIR=$D X=sk timeout 60 bash bin/cli providers add anthropic --credential-env X --dry-run; echo "exit=$? entradas=$(ls -A "$D" | wc -l)"; rm -rf "${D:?}"
timeout 600 bash bin/check_package_typecheck --strict cli 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
